'''Parate''' is a parasite-exclusive [[Effects|effect]] introduced by the Mod. 
*If a parasite kills a mob under this effect, the parasite will partially absorb the victim's attributes (Health, Damage, Armor). Affected by Amplifier.
*Parate cannot be removed by drinking Milk.

== ''Obtainment'' ==
[[Stage I Rooter|Rooter]] applies Parate to any parasite in it's range.

The Parate effect potency doesn't stack.
